MFANO LOSS ASSESSORS AND ADJUSTERS
PRELIMINARY LOSS REPORT
Insured | Amani Bakers Limited
Date of loss | 3 August 2024
Date instructed | 5 August 2024
Cause | Fire, oven room, suspected overheating
We attended the premises on 5th August 2024 at the request of the insurer. Two deck ovens, one spiral mixer and finished stock were destroyed. The electrical installation outside the oven room was intact.
Item | Claimed (KES) | Assessed (KES)
Deck ovens x2 | 8,400,000 | 7,650,000
Spiral mixer | 2,150,000 | 1,980,500
Stock | 3,700,000 | 3,350,000
Total | 14,250,000 | 12,980,500
